description: This is a test source file in Swift for the GatewayProcessManager component of the OpenClaw project, containing unit tests that verify Gateway process management and websocket interactions.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManagerTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for GatewayProcessManager verifying gateway connectivity, health, and process management via websocket session mocks.

methods.name: clears last failure when health succeeds
methods.description: Unit test that verifies the GatewayProcessManager clears its last failure reason upon successful health check.

methods.name: attaches to existing gateway without spawning launchd
methods.description: Unit test that verifies GatewayProcessManager can attach to an existing gateway process and correctly interpret its status.
